question: Yay! Okay, so I'm going to start with just some questions that I wrote down. I've got a number of questions and we'll just try to get through some of them this morning. Is that okay?

question: What do you remember about? About?
answer_text: Your early days in Hong Kong. I remember when my younger brother and sister was born. I'm the one who take care of them. I, at that time, my mom is not really healthy. So I have to take them outside so my mom can get a nap. So I have Johnny on my back. And Nancy, I hold her. And Nancy, I hold her hand. So at that time, we don't have too much thing to play. We go to Iran to go in a, randomly, the truck. We go around there and play. So at my young age, my back is a little bit curved. Even when I grow up because I was doing that when I, my young age. And there's certain time. I go to. I go to my auntie. Young Lou Dosa in New York, the one, that lady. At that time, she don't have any children. So I remember a certain time, I go to sleep at her place. With, you know.

Before we share one small flat. We have so many units there. And then we live in one of the unit. And we sleep in a bed. Because not enough to hold that many people. So we have to do that way. question: For how long?
answer_text: Maybe couple years. I don't remember. Yeah. Because, and then they only have one toilet. Sometimes we cannot hold it. We go to the kitchen. The kitchen is concrete. So they just .

answer_text: Yeah. Yeah. Yeah. Yeah. Yeah. Yeah. Yeah. Yeah. Yeah. Yeah. Yeah. Yeah. Yeah. Yeah! That's a practice. Yeah. Interesting. Interesting.

answer_text: That's like the . At that age, we didn't think about it. But then when we go to school they say, what you want to be. Then I say nurse. Because that's something that we can, for some reason, if we are in cubist, that's more comfortable. And they want to learn more teachers now.

And she promoted one level up, and I took her to register to the school. Not my elder sister. My elder sister is five years older, but I'm the one.

question: And then where was your, you said your mom was the one who took care of you? My mom was sick the whole time?

And then it was changed to a bigger boat. Yeah. Yeah. Yeah. Yeah. Yeah. Yeah.

question: And it was the club house of the first ship?

question_zh: 那是一艘大船嗎?

question: Huh?
